title: Resolution granting tax break for affordable housing in Queens
summary: This resolution approves a property tax exemption for a housing development at Block 12334, Lot 273 in Queens, owned by WFHA St. Albans LLC and Albans Housing Development Fund Corporation. The exemption can last up to 40 years from an effective date and requires the property to remain affordable housing under an HPD regulatory agreement. It would end if the owner fails to comply with program rules or transfers the property without HPD's approval.
